_comment: REVERTED 2026-09-29 10:28 EDT (task t_9c9fa3de) at HEAD fc416e2: the `content_compare` rule list is now EMPTY, so no path is content-compared and every `.gz` below run/ is compared by container bytes, exactly like every other manifested file. This file stays as an empty-rule overlay -- a file in this directory with no `scenarios` key carries registry-level keys, so the revert is one file and its history sits next to it. The amendment it used to carry (task t_091ec5b8, 2026-09-28) was: `run/**/*.gz` was compared by its GUNZIPPED PAYLOAD instead of by container bytes, because the recorded goldens are upstream-zlib level-6 deflate (apple libz 1.2.12, vanilla zlib 1.2.12 and vanilla zlib 1.3.1 all reproduce every one of the 1317 recorded containers byte-for-byte) while every compression library then available to the port wrote a different deflate stream for the same content (node 22.22.2's *linked* zlib is Google's patched 'motley' fork: 25/150 and 25/1167 containers -- an engine count, not a fact about node: a node linked against upstream zlib 1.2.12 reproduces 150/150 and 1167/1167 with the same call, t_16ac7810/t_ceaf2128 -- and Chrome 153 CompressionStream('deflate-raw'|'gzip'): 26/190). Its named durable fix was lane card t_431ed2f0, which has landed: `src/model/compress/zlibDeflate.ts` transcribes upstream zlib's deflate (level 6 / memLevel 8 / windowBits -15 / Z_DEFAULT_STRATEGY / single Z_FINISH), so the port writes byte-identical containers and no exception is needed. The container is still the compression library's fingerprint and the payload is still what the model produces -- that reading was never wrong, it just no longer forces an amendment. The mechanism remains available and unchanged: a scenario may opt in with its own `content_compare` list, `--content-compare <glob>` re-selects a path for a single check, `--no-content-compare` forces strict bytes, and the checker counts and prints every file it compares that way -- a payload difference, a missing file and an unreadable container are still hard failures. See PORT_SPEC.md -> Frozen surface, PARITY.md -> Deviations and docs/specs/gzip-containers.md.
